name: The hit-confirm
citation: library/mk2/arcade.frames.json: mileena/HK/far/gap_px 71 -> on_hit +3, on_block -20, damage 32, hitstop 12, connect_range 99. mileena/HP/far/gap_px 71 -> on_hit +4, damage 11. reptile/HK/far -> damage 32, connect_range 110.
claim: Mileena's far HK is +3 on hit and -20 on block. The SAME button, the same frame, the same spacing: the only variable is whether Reptile held Block. Hit -> she keeps the turn and walks back in for free. Blocked -> the turn transfers and she eats a 32-damage punish through her own guard.

beats.name: far-HK-hits
beats.note: Reptile is NOT guarding: 32 damage, contact f8. Mileena then holds Block from f3 for the rest of the sequence, so every later counter is classified by chip-vs-full damage.

beats.name: no-punish-on-hit
beats.note: The IDENTICAL punish program Reptile runs in the blocked branch (far HK at contact+29) -- here it reaches nothing: the hit knocked him to a 149 px gap, outside his 110 px connect range, and he is in hitstun besides.

beats.name: she-keeps-the-turn
beats.note: +3 on hit is spent on APPROACH: she drops guard, walks 30 frames back from 154 px to 75 px, and lands far HP for 11. Reptile starts guarding at local f47.

beats.name: same-button-blocked
beats.note: Same far HK, same f8 contact -- but Reptile is holding Block, so it is 8 chip instead of 32, and she is -20. She re-guards at local f3; he drops guard at contact+1.

beats.name: the-turn-transfers
beats.note: Reptile counters at HIS earliest actionable frame (contact+21). It lands 32 on a Mileena who has been holding Block for 26 frames -- her guard has not returned, so this is a PUNISH, not a hit she chose to eat.

notes: The brief's close HP punisher is IMPOSSIBLE here and that is a finding, not a substitution: a blocked far HK adds +24 px of pushback, and Reptile's HP has a 72 px connect range, so no rung of this ladder (floor 61 px) leaves him inside HP range afterwards. The punisher that works is his far HK (110 px).
